pass_2.locations: Yan JATS lines 80–88/130–138/199–220/331–332; all six publisher supplement headings/pertinent rows; Protocol Exchange v2 lines 89–110 and 235–269; official Illumina source table and Rev C manual
pass_2.finding: Independently followed all six publisher supplements and Protocol Exchange/Illumina links. Original data identify classic and modified BLISS break adapters, and official documents identify the RA3/RTP/RP1/RPI family. The separate author Protocol Exchange Supplementary Table 2 remains unobtained; neither paper nor vendor selects a universal RPI sample index or proves custom RA3 end modifications.

missing_claims.claim: The selected RPI index member and custom-synthesis RA3 end modifications for a particular original BLISS sample remain unresolved; the RA3/RTP/RP1/RPI sequence family and reaction order are published.
missing_claims.evidence: Two independent reads of author Protocol Exchange and original Illumina sequence table. Separate Protocol Exchange Supplementary Table 2 remains unavailable, and no source selects one RPI member or specifies custom RA3 end modification for each sample.

conclusion: Two independent reads now cover paper, six publisher supplements, author Protocol Exchange PDF and Illumina family sources. Protocol Exchange Supplementary Table 2 and sample-specific/custom-end details remain blocked; no absence accepted.
